changes.amendment_text: in Schedule 2, in Annexure 3 under the heading of Conditions of License, for serial number 8 and entries relating thereto, the following shall be substituted, namely:- “8. Maintain daily records of production, raw materials utilization separately: Provided that this condition shall not be applicable to non-manufacturing food businesses.”

in Schedule 4, in Part-II, in heading of General Requirements on Hygienic and Sanitary Practices to be followed by all Food Business Operators applying for License, under sub-heading FOOD OPERATIONS AND CONTROLS, for paragraph 5.2.5, the following requirement shall be substituted, namely:- “5.2.5 The storage of raw materials, ingredients, work-in-progress and processed or cooked or packaged food products shall be subjected to First in First out, First Expire First Out, which shall not be applicable to retailers.”
